messages.text:
BL-784 — six long-running supervisors are absent from daemon_log_freshness.conf, and none of them heartbeats — registering one as-is would restart a healthy daemon for being quiet
What it solves: If the coder finds a seventh loop daemon while wiring the guard, it is in
scope — the invariant is over the class, not over the six names listed. That
list is evidence of the gap, not its boundary.
Approval context: Medium, and deliberately behind BL-783: until something installs the cron, adding rows to this conf changes nothing observable. Promoting this first would produce a green ticket and a still-dark watchdog.
One decision needs sign-off: the scope. The coordinator reported ONE unwatched daemon (`cursor…
BL-784 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-784" (or "reject BL-784 <reason>") to act.
